title: Rav Chaviva son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him once in a halakhic discussion, in [Avodah Zarah 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.34b.1), saying: “This grape pomace of Arameans is permitted after twelve months.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Acha son of Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage attributes the grape-pomace ruling to Rav Acha son of Rav Ika. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Avodah_Zarah.34b.1.3) explains portzanei as grape refuse.
The next ruling, about jars, is attributed to Rav Acha son of Rava. Hyman’s heading gives Chaviva son of Rava and his citation of Dikdukei Soferim gives Acha son of Rava for the pomace ruling.
